## Done means (CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Covered by tests (`npm test`; e2e when the page or the service worker changed)
- [ ] Checked in a browser (a production build for anything the service worker touches)
- [ ] Described in the README or `docs/`; a choice between options got an ADR
- [ ] `npm run format`, and `npm run openapi` after a schema change
- [ ] A new text is in all 8 locale files; a new service or stored data is in `/privacy`
